en: The image shows a historical photograph of a large brick building complex, likely an industrial facility, with a prominent multi-story main building and adjacent structures, including a tall smokestack. In the foreground, there are fenced garden plots with pathways and small sheds. The overall setting is urban, with more buildings visible in the background. The text at the bottom of the postcard reads 'Unionbrauerei — Meissen. Brauhausstrasse Nr. 15.'
